page.overview:
What is Nidoking?

Nidoking is a large purple Pokémon with a very large horn and large ears. It has a large, bulky tail, and he has one-toed feet and three-fingered hands. He now stands upright, unlike his previous Evolution, Nidorino.

A Nidoking attacks its foes by sweeping his large and bulky tail, and his horn also contains venom.

In Nidoran families, Nidoking assume the roles of protectors and hunters, patrolling in search of food to bring back to their burrows for their mates and offspring. An enraged Nidoking is particularly dangerous, as it will go on a rampage that can only be stopped either by defeating the Pokémon—a difficult task that only a few Pokémon can accomplish—or by being calmed down by its partner Nidoqueen. Threatening their families is one of the most common triggers for such attacks. Luckily, their rarity in the wild in combination with their tendency to stay away from human settlements makes berserk Nidoking a very rare, albeit still very dangerous, problem in most metropolitan areas.

Nidoking's horn is full of poison, capable of shattering diamonds. Its tail can sweep telephone poles as if they were matchsticks.
